ModMetaData.name: Enhanced Carrying Capacity – Save Loading Fix [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Prevent a save-loading failure caused by Enhanced Carrying Capacity loading its settings during caravan restoration FEATURES The fix loads the original mod's settings during normal startup, before a save is loaded. Carrying-capacity multipliers and offsets stay unchanged, and the fix adds no data to saves Enable the fix before loading the affected save COMPATIBILITY RimWorld 1.6. Requires Enhanced Carrying Capacity (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2972540973). Load this mod after it. Harmony is not required Can be added to an existing save. The fix can be removed without removing save data, but the original loading error may return FEEDBACK Found a bug?
